principle: Verifiable assurance for specific claims in a specific context at a specific time; never a universal trust score.

scope: payment intent expiry and replay blocking
review/block do not execute in mediator model
limitations: bounded finite-state verification, not proof of every possible program/environment state
does not prove external-world truth or upstream registry integrity
does not prove arbitrary LLM correctness
does not yet prove every downstream execution adapter is equivalent to the abstract mediator

globalProofs.claim: A machine buyer successfully paid for bounded computation while paymentGrantedAuthority remained false.

capabilities.formalCoverage: authority/freshness/evidence/human-review invariants in bounded production-kernel model

proves: matching active explicit grant exists or does not exist
doesNotProve: that an upstream identity/credential source is uncompromised

proves: observation timestamp satisfies explicit max-age policy
doesNotProve: that fresh information is substantively correct

proves: claims are covered by supplied evidence references
doesNotProve: that a cited source or claim is substantively true

proves: bounded supplied identifiers match under the published scoring rule
doesNotProve: external registry identity unless a verified registry provider is connected

proves: bounded evaluation can be invoked through the provider adapter when configured
doesNotProve: universal correctness of an evaluated output

capabilities.formalCoverage: bounded exhaustive combinations of merchant verification/identity, beneficiary, amount, currency, intent expiry, mandate/human approval and replay
proves: proposed payment remains exactly bound to supplied merchant/beneficiary/amount/currency intent
expired intent and detected replay block
allow requires verified mandate or observed human approval
the assurance check itself never executes payment and payment never grants authority

nextPromotionGates: bind exact public build SHA into proof registry
buyer adjudication of false positives and false negatives
